subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers adopt, rebase, or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 to remove ambient `process.cwd()` from transcript header creation, or intentionally defer this to broader cwd-isolation work?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the metadata crosses session/workspace security boundaries and an open closing PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
options.body: Rebase or replace the open linked PR so mirrored transcript headers use an explicit target workspace and this issue can close after merge.

options.title: Close the stale PR and queue a replacement
options.body: If the current branch is too stale or conflicted to salvage, close it only after a narrow replacement path is ready.

options.title: Defer to broader cwd isolation
options.body: Keep this issue open for a larger runtime cleanup, accepting that mirrored transcript headers can still record ambient cwd until then.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the open linked PR so mirrored transcript headers use an explicit target workspace and this issue can close after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history-backed owner for delivery mirroring and later mirror dedupe changes in the implicated path.
